gaps.fact: How the method shapes the pairing: autolytic traditional method wines with salty, fried and rich dishes, fruit led tank wines with lighter food and fruit desserts, off dry Asti with pastry; the method decides the style and the style the plate. No stem or chapter fact pairs by method.

The cost of each method and where it sits in a programme by the bottle and by the glass: Champagne and traditional method at the top, Crémant and Cava as the value traditional method tier, Prosecco and tank wines as the by the glass workhorse, so a list offers bubbles at several price points.

The gyropalette's importance in time, cost and efficacy: a cage of hundreds of bottles riddled in about a week against six to eight weeks by hand on a pupitre, with less labour and a consistent result. Named in two Régionale explanations (i-npq5yzfu, which alone gives the time and the count; i-g0ue14ni), as a distractor in i-o5pdu5lu and in the champagne article (made); no stem asks it.

Know what liqueur de tirage (base wine, sugar and yeast, with a riddling aid) and liqueur d'expédition (wine and sugar, the dosage) are made of. Two Régionale Champagne stems key them (i-bcfxzxtd the tirage, i-kelb2xyi the expédition) and the Village Champagne chapter's method fact names the tirage as wine with sugar and yeast and the dosage as the liqueur d'expédition; no Village stem asks what either is made of, and c-24i3ytdv names the tirage's sugar and yeast only as a distractor.
The Court's figures: the second fermentation complete in four to five days, as little as ninety days from harvest to bottling, and the method's fit for aromatic varieties.

courtUpdates.now: DO Cava's Guarda Superior tier (Reserva, Gran Reserva, Paraje Calificado) must come wholly from certified organic vineyards: a rule set in the 2020 restructure, applied to Guarda Superior wines released from 2025, which the Consejo reports as made from the 2022 harvest onwards.
